videos.title: Holy Shock Ret Beats Unsealed Wrath? We Ran the Numbers | WoW Forever
videos.description:
Two Ret Paladins after the 30 October hotfixes: Unsealed Wrath or Holy Shock, which one hits harder on WoW Forever, and what should each wear? We ran the numbers, and we tested how to play the new talent.

Our sim results (60 s, level 60 Human, raid buffed, pre-raid gear):
Humanoid: Unsealed Wrath 775 DPS, Holy Shock 804 DPS (about 4% more)
Demon: Unsealed Wrath 823 DPS, Holy Shock 906 DPS (about 10% more)
Swapping seals every swing vs stacking 3: 775 vs 742 on a humanoid, 823 vs 800 on a demon.
We don't push stacking, and a missed twist is still a loss. Stacks are one more mechanic to play with, like saving a burst for an add or in PvP. In a constant fight, aim to twist every swing.

videos.title: Shadowform Halves Your Mana Costs in WoW Forever (Shadow Priest) #shorts #wowforever
videos.description:
Shadowform in WoW Forever (Wowhead tooltip): +10% Shadow damage, -50% mana cost of all Shadow spells, +100% critical strike damage bonus for Shadow spells, -15% physical damage taken.
In Classic it gave +15% Shadow damage. Level 60 ranks also hit a bit softer:
- Mind Blast: 508-537 → 485-511 (350 mana, so 175 in Shadowform)
- Mind Flay: 426 → 390
- Shadow Word: Pain: 852 → 762
"You'll drink less, not hit harder" is my reading of these numbers.

videos.title: Holy Shock Ret Beats Unsealed Wrath? We Ran the Numbers | WoW Forever
videos.description:
Two Ret Paladins after the 30 October hotfixes: Unsealed Wrath or Holy Shock, which one hits harder on WoW Forever, and what should each wear? We ran the numbers, and we tested how to play the new talent.

Our sim results (60 s, level 60 Human, raid buffed, pre-raid gear):
Humanoid: Unsealed Wrath 775 DPS, Holy Shock 804 DPS (about 4% more)
Demon: Unsealed Wrath 823 DPS, Holy Shock 906 DPS (about 10% more)
Swapping seals every swing vs stacking 3: 775 vs 742 on a humanoid, 823 vs 800 on a demon.
We don't push stacking, and a missed twist is still a loss. Stacks are one more mechanic to play with, like saving a burst for an add or in PvP. In a constant fight, aim to twist every swing.
